content.text: {"id": "mm6222a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During June 30–July 13, 2012, a total of 32 deaths (0.11 deaths per 100,000 population) from excessive heat exposure were reported"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "a median of four and average of eight (range: 1–29) heat-related deaths occurred in the four states"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "0.11 deaths per 100,000 population"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "In 5,201 (72%) of these deaths, the underlying cause was exposure to excessive heat"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Overall, 22 (69%) decedents died at home, with lack of air conditioning reported in 20 (91%) of these deaths."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 22 (69%) decedents died at home, with lack of air conditioning reported in 20 (91%) of these deaths."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a median of four and average of eight (range: 1–29) heat-related deaths occurred in the four states"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A lower fatality rate for heat-related deaths was reported in the 2012 EHE than in previous EHEs lasting 10–14 days"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report describes 32 heat-related deaths in Maryland, Ohio, Virginia, and West Virginia"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a median of four and average of eight (range: 1–29) heat-related deaths occurred in the four states"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "in these four states over the same 2-week summer period each year of 1999–2009 was calculated using mortality data from CDC"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Only reports that covered a similar length of time (10–14 days) were included;
